The mechanism is grounded in the diff; exact downstream expectations of handleWebexResponse aren't fully visible, so confidence is moderate.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts, the code wraps the existing fetch call in refreshOAuthTokens(). The refreshOAuthTokens function (in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) either calls the external CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT or falls back to calling the original refreshFunction(). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is false or userId is null, it simply calls the original refresh function unchanged. The parseRefreshTokenResponse function is NOT used in the Webex adapter - the code still uses handleWebexResponse() to process the response. The finding claims Webex rejects responses that don't match its schema, but the diff shows the original Webex response handling is preserved when not using credential sharing.
